coverage.expression_date_handling: Each retrieved work includes frbr_uri and expression_date; GroundedProvider surfaces expression_date in source metadata so answers state the law as of the cited expression date without guessing unindexed amendments

corrections_and_takedowns: Zero local passage caching: Civis stores only citation metadata (title, citation, canonical URL) on verified messages and never caches statutory or judgment text in Postgres or Redis, so upstream Laws.Africa/ULII corrections, repeals, or removals take effect immediately on the next query
